purpose: Describe two actions recurring in a repeated cycle.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I keep writing and erasing, writing and erasing, and the letter goes nowhere.
The waves kept rolling in and receding, again and again.
The child played by repeatedly stacking blocks and knocking them down.
restrictions: The recurring sequence is central; often the same pair repeats.
mistake: This is not the negative-result conditional in every ては sentence.
